en: ʿizba came to refer to the spatial and social organization of cultivators, supervisors, and owner that constituted the estate.
zh: 用来指构成地产的耕种者、监工和业主的空间与社会组织。

en: The geometry of these sites expressed the new power over the cultivators that the estate system made possible. From a more recent period, the inhabitant of a medium-sized estate with ninety-five acres of land that was broken up after the 1952 agrarian reform remembered it as a prison. “The duwwar was surrounded by the houses of the zurraʿ (sharecroppers), and this was the whole ʿizba at the time. There was a gate which closed at night. It was like a concentration camp.”

French scholars who carried out an extensive study of the ʿizba in the 1930s described it as “a private village, where the proprietor is the absolute master. The houses are his private property. The fellahs whom he employs are there at his invitation; at any moment he can send them away if he pleases, without being accountable to anyone.”

Not only the worker houses, in fact, but their tools and equipment, even domestic animals, were usually the property of the estate owner. The larger estates had “a veritable brigade of employees whose sole occupation was to supervise the workers, continuously and in the closest and most rigorous fashion.”
The system enabled the proprietor or manager of the estate “to know his people directly, their needs, their likes and dislikes, their good and bad habits.”
zh: 这些场所的几何布局，表达了地产制度使耕种者处于其下的新权力。一座九十五费丹的中型地产在1952年土地改革后被拆散，其一名居民回忆说，它就像一座监狱。“杜瓦尔被祖拉（zurraʿ，分成制佃农）的房屋围着，当时整个伊兹巴就是这样。有一道夜里关闭的大门。那就像一座集中营。”
20世纪30年代对伊兹巴进行大规模研究的法国学者把它描述为“一座私人村庄，业主是绝对的主人。房屋是他的私有财产。他雇用的费拉赫是应他之邀住在那里的；他随时可以随意把他们赶走，无须向任何人负责。”
事实上，不仅工人的住房，连他们的工具、设备乃至家畜，通常都是地产主的财产。较大的地产拥有“名副其实的雇员大队，其唯一职责就是持续不断地、以最密切和最严格的方式监督工人”。
这一制度使地产主或管理人能够“直接了解他的人员，了解他们的需要、好恶、好习惯和坏习惯”。

en: powers of exception
zh: 例外之权

en: European legal theory understood the right of property as the control over things. Since at least Montesquieu, this private right (dominium in Roman law) was contrasted with sovereignty (imperium), or the rule over people. Property belonged to individuals, while sovereignty was the power of the state. But in practice, in both Europe and Egypt, property was a power relation among people as well as things. At a minimum, it was a power to exclude others from taking or using certain things. If people needed those things to survive, then property rights conferred much wider powers, including the ability to make people do as the owner wished.

The proprietor of the estates that spread across the Nile valley was a sovereign, an “absolute master.” He was accountable to no one. He could imprison, expel, starve, exploit, and exercise many other forms of arbitrary, exceptional, and, if necessary, violent powers. The law of property claimed to be a universal right, based upon undisputed principles true in every country. But this general truth enclosed within it a zone of arbitrariness. The walls of the ʿizba encircled a realm of exception, within which power operated without rights. The architecture that formed the enclosed agricultural colony, a microcolonialism within a larger colonial domain, went hand in hand with a legal architecture that constructed territories of arbitrary power within the larger space of legal reason and abstraction.
zh: 欧洲法律理论把产权理解为对物的控制。至少自孟德斯鸠以来，这种私权（罗马法中的dominium）就与主权（imperium），即对人的统治，相对举。产权属于个人，主权则是国家的权力。但在实践中，无论在欧洲还是埃及，产权既是人与物之间的关系，也是人与人之间的权力关系。最低限度上，它是一种排除他人取用或使用某些物品的权力。如果人们需要那些物品才能生存，那么产权就赋予远为广泛的权力，包括使人按业主意愿行事的能力。

在尼罗河谷蔓延的地产，其业主就是一位主权者，一位“绝对的主人”。他不向任何人负责。他可以监禁、驱逐、使人挨饿、剥削，并行使许多其他形式的专断、例外、必要时暴力的权力。产权法声称是一种普遍权利，建立在每个国家都成立的不容置疑的原则之上。但这一普遍真理内部包含着一段专断的地带。伊兹巴的围墙圈出一个例外领域，权力在其中不依权利而运作。形成这座封闭农业殖民地的建筑——更大殖民领域内的微型殖民主义——与另一种法律建筑并行：后者在法律理性和抽象性的更大空间内，构筑出专断权力的领地。

en: The power of this sovereignty was constituted not only within the estate, but from the relations between the enclosed domain of the estate and the wider countryside in which it stood. The estate could operate as a sort of prison, in part because to escape from the estate meant to become both landless and homeless. Reinforcing the discipline created by the walls and gates of the ʿizba was the power generated by the wider arrangements of which it was a part. This was the other side of the successful control of labor: the expansion of the estate system to eliminate the opportunity of escape to a less coercive alternative. One estimate indicates that by 1863 estates already covered more than one-seventh of the cultivated area.

Over the next twelve years their area almost doubled. A local writer noted the exploitation now suffered by landless agricultural laborers, who were “compelled to work for whatever wages it is possible to get from the owners, depending upon their pleasure, even though this amount be extremely small and incommensurate with the labor. This is particularly so in areas where there are a great many workers, who then accept diminished wages and compete with one another in this, to the benefit of the landowners.”

The landless were as much a part of the arrangement as the workers tied to the estate. Their role lay not just in the discipline they helped enforce among estate workers by their availability to replace them, but in the provision of extra labor at harvest and other periods of peak demand for which the proprietor did not have to provide year-round support. There developed mobile brigades of workers, controlled by labor contractors and overseers, resulting in a dual labor force.

The estate represented a method of fixing workers in place and at the same time making other workers mobile. Both the fixing and the mobility depended upon the rapid removal of land from village control and its transformation into estates.
zh: 这种主权的权力不仅在地产内部构成，也由地产这个封闭领域与其所在的更广阔乡村之间的关系构成。地产之所以能像一座监狱那样运作，部分是因为逃离地产意味着同时失去土地和家园。强化伊兹巴的围墙和大门所造就的纪律的，是地产所属的更广泛安排所产生的权力。这是成功控制劳动力的另一面：地产制度的扩张消灭了逃往强制较少的替代处所的机会。一项估计表明，到1863年，地产已覆盖耕地的七分之一以上。
此后十二年间，地产面积几乎翻了一番。一位当地作家指出了无地农业劳工此时遭受的剥削，他们“被迫接受能从地主那里得到的任何工资，全凭他们的高兴，哪怕这笔钱极其微薄，与劳动不相称。在工人大量集中的地区尤其如此：那里的工人接受更低的工资，并为此相互竞争，让地主获益。”
无地者和依附于地产的工人一样，都是这一安排的一部分。他们的作用不仅在于：他们随时可以替代地产工人，从而帮助在地产工人中维持纪律；还在于在收获和其他需求高峰期提供额外劳动力，而业主无须为此提供全年的供养。由包工头和监工控制的流动工人队发展起来，由此形成双重劳动力。
地产代表了一种把工人固定在原地的办法，同时也使另一些工人保持流动。固定和流动都依赖于迅速把土地从村庄控制中夺走，并将其转变为地产。

en: A census carried out on the eve of the occupation in 1882 indicated that there were then five thousand estates in the Delta alone, housing 12 percent of the population. Three years later regulations were introduced to govern the creation of estates, restricting them to properties of more than fifty acres. Yet by 1901, half the country’s agricultural land was held in estates of this size. In 1912, in a further attempt to slow down the rate at which villagers were losing their land and their homes, the British introduced the Five Feddan Law. Modeled on a similar measure in the Punjab, the law prevented creditors seizing from small farmers their last five acres (feddans) of land, their essential farm tools, two draft animals, and their house. Nevertheless, by the 1920s it was estimated that more than onethird of the agricultural population in the Delta had become landless, while the number of estates in the country as a whole had reached about seventeen thousand.
In an official list of place names published in 1932, more than half the localities listed were private estates.
zh: 1882年占领前夕进行的一次人口普查显示，仅三角洲就有五千处地产，居住着12%的人口。三年后出台了规范地产创设的条例，将其限制在五十费丹以上的产业。但到1901年，全国一半的农业土地掌握在这种规模的地产手中。1912年，为再次减缓村民失去土地和家园的速度，英国人推出了《五费丹法》。该法仿照旁遮普的一项类似措施，禁止债权人夺取小农最后五费丹土地、基本农具、两头役畜和房屋。然而，到20世纪20年代，据估计三角洲超过三分之一的农业人口已经无地，而全国地产数量已达到约一万七千处。
在1932年出版的一份官方地名表中，所列地点的半数以上是私人地产。

en: These islands of sovereignty were in the majority of cases seized from villages. It is impossible to determine exactly what proportion of the land taken as estates was previously uncultivated and what proportion was cultivated land or pasture belonging to villages. Some of the so-called uncultivated land had been made that way by the failed coercions of earlier decades, and other areas had formed part of the transhumant agriculture of the Bedouins forcibly ended by the government. These issues aside, the decline in the taxable area of village lands between 1863 and 1875 suggests that about two-thirds of the land taken as estates was cultivated village land. The villages may have lost even more, for many of the lands taken as estates continued to be registered as village land.
Barakat has shown how large proportions of the estate land seized by Ismaʿil and his predecessors was taken directly from the villages.

Even when estates were formed from land officially categorized as uncultivated, untaxed, or abandoned, it was sometimes at the expense of the villages. The recipient of the uncultivated lands of a village would in some cases forcibly exchange them for an area of more fertile village land already under cultivation, claiming the need for a consolidated acreage for the estate in place of the dispersed fragments of less fertile, uncultivated soil.
Villagers themselves later made it clear that they considered the big estates to have been created largely by the appropriation of cultivated village land.
zh: 这些主权之岛大多是从村庄夺取的。无法确切判定，在被划为地产的土地中，有多少原先是未开垦地，有多少是属于村庄的耕地或牧场。部分所谓的未开垦地，是此前几十年强制失败后变成这样的；另一些地区原本属于被政府强行终结的贝都因人季节性游牧农业。撇开这些问题不谈，1863年至1875年间村庄土地应税面积的下降表明，被划为地产的土地约三分之二是村庄的耕地。村庄失去的也许更多，因为许多被划为地产的土地仍继续登记为村庄土地。
巴拉卡特（Barakat）表明，伊斯梅尔及其前任夺取的地产土地中，有相当大的比例是直接从村庄拿走的。
即使地产是用官方归类为未开垦、免税或荒弃的土地组成，有时也是以牺牲村庄为代价。在某些情况下，一个村庄未开垦地的受赐者会强行把这些地换成一片已经耕种的、更肥沃的村地，理由是他需要一处连片的面积来构成地产，以取代分散的、不那么肥沃的未开垦地块。
村民后来自己明确表示，他们认为大地产主要是通过侵占村庄耕地形成的。

en: A further means of control was provided by the mechanism of debt. With the village itself under private sovereignty, cultivators could now be required to work for less than a living wage. The typical arrangement was to employ the workers without payment or below subsistence wages on the labor-intensive cotton crop, which was grown on a three-year (sometimes two-year) rotation. On the land rotated out of cotton the workers grew food and fodder crops, each worker receiving a small plot to provide for the subsistence of his household and surrendering the rest of the crop to the owner. In some cases the workers rented rather than sharecropped their subsistence plots, but in either case the owner tended to retain control of irrigation and the choice of crops. Only the owners had a surplus to sell, so they alone had access to capital. The owners therefore provided the working capital for the subsistence plots. When workers were unable to repay this or other loans they were placed in debt bondage to the owner. The wages for working on the cotton crop were then absorbed in debt and interest payments, and the workers became an unpaid, bonded workforce.
zh: 债务机制提供了另一种控制手段。村庄本身处于私人主权之下，耕种者现在可以被要求以低于维生工资的报酬劳动。典型的安排是：在劳动密集的棉花作物上无偿雇用工人，或支付低于维生水平的工资；棉花按三年（有时两年）轮作种植。在轮作退出棉花的土地上，工人种植粮食和饲料作物，每个工人得到一小块地以维持家庭生计，其余收成交给业主。在某些情况下，工人是租种而不是分成耕种他们的维生地块，但无论哪种情况，业主往往保留对灌溉和作物选择的控制。只有业主有可供出售的余粮，因此只有他们能获得资本。于是业主为维生地块提供周转资金。当工人无力偿还这笔或其他贷款时，便沦为业主的债奴。在棉花上劳动的工资随即被债务和利息吞噬，工人于是成为一支无偿的、被束缚的劳动力。

en: The mechanism of debt was not only a power available within the sovereign space of the estate. In 1876 the government agreed with thirteen European powers and the United States to establish the Mixed Courts, a parallel judicial system based on French law governing legal relations between foreigners and local subjects.

Administered mostly by foreign lawyers and judges, the new courts for the first time enabled creditors to seize ownership of a cultivator’s land for nonpayment of debt. In five years fifty thousand acres in a single province were lost by distraint to moneylenders, who ranged from large mortgage banks to the small Greek and Levantine traders that had opened shops in almost every village.
A British parliamentary inquiry later reported that the local population regarded the courts simply as “a machine for transferring the land” from the native cultivators to their creditors.

Once again the law of private property created a power that was much more than a control over things. It manufactured this “machine” that concentrated into certain hands enormous powers of violence. An individual creditor could now use its force to evict a farmer from the land, seize possession of draft animals and ploughs, and demolish houses. Since the Mixed Courts did not govern relations among local subjects, but only those between locals and foreigners, this power was another enclave of privilege reserved for Europeans, another exceptional power made possible by a supposedly universal law.
zh: 债务机制不仅是地产主权空间内可用的一种权力。1876年，政府与十三个欧洲国家及美国议定设立混合法院；这是一个基于法国法的平行司法体系，管辖外国人与本地臣民之间的法律关系。
新法院主要由外国律师和法官主持，首次使债权人能够因债务人未偿债而夺取耕种者的土地所有权。五年之内，仅一个省就有五万费丹土地因扣押抵债落入放债人手中；放债人既包括大型抵押银行，也包括几乎在每个村庄开店的小希腊商人和黎凡特商人。
英国议会的一项调查后来报告说，当地居民干脆把这些法院视为“一台转移土地的机器”，把土地从本地耕种者手中转给他们的债权人。
私有产权法再次创造出一种远不止于控制物品的权力。它制造了这台“机器”，把巨大的暴力权力集中到某些人手中。如今单个债权人就可以利用它的力量把农民从土地上赶走，夺取役畜和犁，拆毁房屋。由于混合法院不管辖本地臣民之间的关系，只管本地人与外国人之间的关系，这种权力又是为欧洲人保留的一块特权飞地，又是一种由据称普遍的法律所造成的例外权力。

en: The powers of debt were soon concentrated into a much larger force, providing the leverage for colonial occupation. “By the irony of fate,” as Britain’s colonial governor of Egypt later put it, the machine was used to take over the estates of the country’s largest landowner, Ismaʿil himself, and turn the country into a European colony.

In 1874 a global economic depression began, brought on by the crisis of speculative European banking, including the large loans to Ismaʿil and his government. As the depression caused the price of cotton to fall and made further credit unavailable, Ismaʿil was unable to postpone any longer the financial collapse. In 1876 the banking houses established a Debt Commission in Cairo, which took control of the country’s finances and used the new Mixed Courts to take possession of Ismaʿil’s estates. When Ismaʿil resisted the takeover the British and French governments had him deposed in favor of his son Tawfiq. The latter began to lose power to a popular constitutionalist movement, led by junior army officers and disaffected notables.
In 1882 the British invaded the country, established a military occupation to eradicate the populist movement, and reasserted European control over finances, including all of the viceregal estates.
This course of events was ironic, perhaps, but the powers at work were not particularly those of fate.
zh: 债务的权力很快聚集成一股大得多的力量，为殖民占领提供了杠杆。“命运真是讽刺，”英国后来的埃及殖民总督曾说，这台机器被用来接管该国最大的地产主伊斯梅尔本人的地产，并把整个国家变成欧洲的殖民地。
1874年，全球经济萧条开始，其起因是欧洲投机银行业的危机，包括向伊斯梅尔及其政府提供的大笔贷款。萧条使棉花价格下跌、进一步信贷告罄，伊斯梅尔再也无法推迟财政崩溃。1876年，各银行在开罗设立债务委员会，控制了该国财政，并利用新的混合法院占有伊斯梅尔的地产。伊斯梅尔抵制接管，英法政府便将他废黜，扶其子陶菲克继位。陶菲克开始被一场民众立宪运动夺去权力，这场运动由下级军官和心怀不满的显贵领导。
1882年，英国人入侵该国，建立军事占领以铲除民粹运动，并重新确立欧洲对财政的控制，包括对全部总督地产的控制。
这一事态发展也许是讽刺的，但其中运作的权力并非特别属于命运。

en: making a difference
zh: 制造差异

en: The development of the agricultural estate transformed the Nile valley in the nineteenth century. I have argued that we should describe this development not as “the emergence of private property,” but as the development of new ways to manage those who farmed the land, achieved after earlier failures, through new methods of devolution, incarceration, surveillance, and exclusion. This is not simply a matter of reversing the image, as has sometimes been proposed. Instead of portraying the estate as the culmination of the development of private rights against the excessive powers of the state, an alternative view portrays it as an arrangement created by the state to bring order to the system of landholding and increase its own powers over rural society.

This image makes better sense of what occurred. Yet the argument that large-scale private property emerged as a more efficient form of state control begins to exceed the terms in which it is expressed. The argument assumes a distinction between rural society or economy and the state. The former is constructed out of private persons and their rights, and the latter consists of public powers. One has to take the distinction between state and society not as the starting point of the analysis, but as an uncertain outcome of the historical process. It is a difference whose genealogy parallels the one we are tracing between the abstraction of law and the materiality of land. The new methods of management cannot be understood in terms of an entity called the state imposing its power upon rural society. What is clear from the details of how the estate emerged is that it was neither exactly an arm of the state nor a private arrangement standing in opposition to the state. This is not because the estate was a dual entity, but because until this period neither state nor society was imagined to exist. As the new methods developed, some took forms that began to be categorized as aspects of the state, and others took forms that would be labeled as part of society. Some of the new powers for the control of land and labor would later appear as public powers, others as private. A vocabulary readily existed for labeling certain practices or bodies as viceregal (miri) and for distinguishing what was public or general (ʿamm) from what was exclusive (khass), but such terms did not correspond to our contemporary vocabulary of state and society or name such distinct entities. Rather, it was out of the new practices that these categories began to emerge.
zh: 农业地产的发展在19世纪改变了尼罗河谷。我曾论证，我们不应把这一发展描述为“私有产权的出现”，而应把它描述为：在先前失败之后，通过授权下放、监禁、监视和排斥的新方法，发展出管理土地耕种者的新方式。这并非像有时所提议的那样，只是把图像颠倒过来。一种替代观点不再把地产描绘成私权对抗国家过度权力的发展顶点，而把它描绘成国家创造的一种安排，用以整顿土地占有制度，并增强国家对农村社会的权力。

这一图像能更好地解释所发生的事情。然而，认为大规模私有产权作为更有效的国家控制形式而出现的论点，开始超出其表述所用的术语。该论点假定农村社会或经济与国家之间存在区别。前者由私人及其权利构成，后者由公共权力组成。人们不能把国家与社会的区分当作分析的起点，而应把它当作历史过程一个不确定的结果。这一差异的谱系，与我们在法律的抽象性和土地的物质性之间所追溯的差异谱系相平行。不能用某个叫作“国家”的实体把权力强加于农村社会来解释这些新的管理方法。从地产如何出现的细节中可以清楚看到，它既不完全是国家的一个分支，也不是与国家相对立的私人安排。这不是因为地产是一个双重实体，而是因为直到这一时期，国家和社会都还未被想象为存在之物。随着新方法的发展，一些方法采取的形式开始被归类为国家的一面，另一些方法采取的形式则被标为社会的组成部分。一些控制土地和劳动力的新权力后来表现为公共权力，另一些则表现为私人权力。当时已有现成的词汇，可以把某些做法或机构标为“米里”（miri，属总督或国库的），并区分“公共或一般”（ʿamm）与“专属”（khass）；但这些词并不对应我们当代的国家与社会词汇，也不指称这类截然不同的实体。相反，正是从这些新做法中，这些范畴才开始形成。

en: The estates granted to officials and servants of the viceroy illustrate this point. The grant was a means of forcing these functionaries to become responsible for extracting tax payments. As new canals and steam pumps made it possible to convert flood basins to year-round cultivation, the grant was also a means to make the recipients responsible for organizing the labor, machinery, and other resources required for converting the land. The estate holders had the local power to command the collection of taxes, but also to command forced labor for irrigation and conversion projects and to police the converted land.
zh: 赐给总督官员和仆役的地产说明了这一点。赐地是一种迫使这些官员负责征收税款的手段。随着新运河和蒸汽抽水机使洪泛盆地有可能改为全年耕作，赐地也成了一种手段，使受赐者负责组织改造土地所需的劳动力、机械和其他资源。地产持有者拥有地方权力，可以指挥征税，也可以为灌溉和改造工程征调强制劳工，并对改造后的土地维持治安。

en: Yet the estates were never mere agencies of the central power. Some estates were formed not by functionaries of the ruling household but by rural lords, tribal heads, or provincial merchants, who enjoyed local networks of power independent of the system of central authority. Even functionaries of the viceroy could use their position to build larger estates, amass personal revenues, and exercise local powers well beyond what the regime in Cairo intended. They made unrecorded acquisitions of land, confiscated land from those unable to pay taxes, or simply seized village land for their own use.

The viceroy’s repeated efforts to prevent government servants from independently enlarging their landholdings suggests the scale of this problem. On October 25, 1864, Ismaʿil instructed the Council of Justice to enforce a ruling issued under his predecessor that prohibited provincial employees—clerks, engineers, surveyors, military officers, medical officers, and others—from purchasing or renting village land in the province in which they were employed.

A year later the viceroy ordered the inspectors of the Upper and Lower Nile to inform all provincial governors that those who held a village district as an official estate were forbidden to purchase privately held land within the district, whether belonging to natives of the district or outsiders.

Ismaʿil also frequently transferred provincial officeholders to new districts, made several unsuccessful efforts to ban the use of unpaid forced labor on estates, and tried more than once to undertake a new land survey and offer rewards for revealing unregistered land.

None of these measures succeeded in keeping provincial officials and other estate holders under control. The local powers generated by the estate system served the purposes of the central authority but always exceeded its control. This excess of power cannot be grasped in terms of any simple distinction between state and society.
zh: 然而，地产从来不只是中央权力的代理机构。有些地产不是由统治家族的官员，而是由乡村领主、部落首领或省城商人建立的；他们拥有独立于中央权威体系的地方权力网络。就连总督的官员也可以利用职位建立更大的地产、聚敛个人收入，并行使远远超出开罗政权意图的地方权力。他们获取土地而不登记，没收无力纳税者的土地，或者径自夺取村庄土地为己所用。
总督一再设法阻止政府人员私自扩大土地占有，可见问题的规模。1864年10月25日，伊斯梅尔指示司法委员会执行其前任发布的一项裁定：禁止省雇员——文书、工程师、测量员、军官、医官等——在其任职省份购买或租种村庄土地。
一年后，总督命令上、下尼罗河巡视官通知所有省长：凡以官职地产形式持有一个村区者，不得购买该村区内的私产土地，无论土地属于本村区人还是外人。
伊斯梅尔还经常把省级任职者调往新区，数次试图禁止在地产上使用无偿强制劳动而未成功，并一再尝试进行新的土地测量，对举报未登记土地者给予奖赏。
这些措施都未能使省官员和其他地产持有者受到控制。地产制度产生的地方权力服务于中央权威的目的，却总是超出其控制。这种权力的溢出，无法用国家与社会的任何简单区分来把握。

en: Even more difficult to analyze in these terms are the estates of the ruling family. Like his predecessors, Ismaʿil made his largest seizures of land to create estates for himself and members of his family. In a single week in October 1863 he took more than thirty thousand acres belonging to twenty-six villages in the province of Sharqiyya and all the land registered as untaxed or uncultivated on the borders of the neighboring province of Daqhaliyya.
By the end of his reign Ismaʿil and his family controlled 916,000 acres, or almost one-fifth of the taxable agricultural area of the country, including much of the most productive land.
The governing power was the largest “private” landowner.
zh: 更难用这些术语分析的是统治家族的地产。与前任一样，伊斯梅尔最大规模的土地夺取是为了给自己和家族成员创造地产。1863年10月的某一周内，他夺走了谢尔基亚省二十六个村庄的三万多费丹土地，以及邻省达卡利亚边界上所有登记为免税或未开垦的土地。
到其统治结束时，伊斯梅尔及其家族控制着91.6万费丹土地，几乎占全国应税农业面积的五分之一，其中包括大量最肥沃的土地。
统治权力本身就是最大的“私人”地产主。

en: The revenue collected on the viceregal estates was not paid into the government treasury but held by the estate itself.

A separate administration was set up to manage the “domain” (daʾira) of each family member, each with its own treasury, staff, and equipment and paying its own salaries and pensions. The domain of Ilhami Pasha, son of Ismaʿil’s uncle and predecessor ʿAbbas, for example, “owned six steamboats, six palaces, 3,855 animals, an unspecified number of factories and carriages, and a primary school for the owner’s male slaves. It paid monthly salaries and pensions of 129,531 piastres to 666 employees and former employees, including translators, accountants, and clerks.”
The domains functioned as separate sovereignties, with far more power and autonomy than ordinary estates. Yet they cannot, as Hunter concludes, “be regarded as extensions of state power.”

Their status became still more ambiguous as they were pledged as security for loans and fell, like the country as a whole, under the control of European financiers. In May 1865 Ismaʿil separated the administration of his own estates from the rest of the family holdings, and pledged them as security for a loan.

In 1878 he signed over the remaining family domains to Rothschilds. The family domains were transferred to the government after the Europeans took control and renamed state domain, to distinguish them from those mortgaged earlier. Yet state domain referred to lands controlled and managed not by the state but by the House of Rothschild. These distinctions were elaborated as a part of the functioning of political control. They do not define two original and neatly separable objects. The domains represented another zone of exception, minisovereignties established by the powers of property, debt, and mortgage, and used as levers of occupation.
zh: 总督地产上征收的收入不缴入政府国库，而由地产自身留存。
每个家族成员的“领地”（daʾira）都设有独立的管理机构，各有自己的金库、人员和设备，自付薪金和养老金。例如，伊斯梅尔的叔父兼前任阿巴斯的儿子伊勒哈米帕夏的领地，“拥有六艘汽船、六座宫殿、3855头牲畜、数量不详的工厂和马车，以及一所为业主的男奴开设的小学”。“它每月向666名在职和离职雇员支付129,531皮阿斯特的薪金和养老金，其中包括译员、会计和文书。”
这些领地作为独立的主权体运作，拥有远大于普通地产的权力和自主性。然而，正如亨特（Hunter）所总结的，它们不能“被视为国家权力的延伸”。
当它们被抵押为贷款担保、并像整个国家一样落入欧洲金融家控制之下时，其地位变得更加模糊。1865年5月，伊斯梅尔把自己地产的管理与家族其余产业分开，并将其抵押为贷款担保。
1878年，他把剩余的家族领地签让给罗斯柴尔德家族。欧洲人接管后，家族领地被移交给政府，并改名为“国有领地”，以区别于先前抵押出去的领地。但“国有领地”指的是由罗斯柴尔德家族而非由国家控制管理的土地。这些区分是作为政治控制运作的一部分而制定出来的。它们并不界定两个原初且可以清楚分开的对象。这些领地代表着另一个例外地带，是由产权、债务和抵押的权力建立的微型主权体，并被用作占领的杠杆。

en: What is the genealogy of the law of property? How do general principles become true in every country? The old answer, set forth in Cairo in 1883 by Artin’s study for the Ministry of Finance, described a series of nineteenthcentury laws, and read them as the steps gradually instituting the principle of private ownership. It presented this process as the history of a conceptual structure, the framework of individual rights. The origin of the structure lay outside the Nile valley, in the rational scheme of European legal theory. Artin’s account reinforces the impression of a nonlocal origin, and thus of law as something ideal, for it abstracts the laws from the actual circumstances and political struggles out of which they came.
zh: 产权法的谱系是什么？普遍原则如何变得在每个国家都成立？旧的答案由阿尔廷1883年为财政部在开罗发表的研究提出：它叙述了19世纪一系列法律，并把它们解读为逐步确立私有制原则的步骤。它把这一过程呈现为一种概念结构——个人权利框架——的历史。这一结构的起源在尼罗河谷之外，在欧陆法律理论的理性方案之中。阿尔廷的叙述强化了起源非本地、因而法律是某种理想之物的印象，因为它把这些法律从产生它们的实际环境和政治斗争中抽象出来。

en: We cannot read such history as an accurate representation of the genealogy of the law. We can, however, read it as a text that, in its silences about actual circumstances and struggles, performs the origins of law. The ideal structure of law is produced by its difference from the particular history and materiality of local events. The absence of the local and the actual in the Ministry of Finance study enacts, and reproduces, the difference. Presenting the law of property as a conceptual structure whose origins lie outside actuality is part of a process that establishes the law in terms of this dualism.
zh: 我们不能把这样的历史当作法律谱系的准确再现来读。然而，我们可以把它读作一个文本：它对实际环境和斗争的沉默，恰恰演示了法律的起源。法律的理想结构，是由它与地方事件的特殊历史和物质性的差异所产生的。财政部研究中对地方和实际的缺席，演示并再生产了这种差异。把产权法呈现为一种起源外在于现实的概念结构，是以这种二元论确立法律的过程的一部分。

en: The local origins of the law are necessarily hidden, for they lie in questions of power, discipline, coercion, and dispossession. They are tied up in specific histories, now largely forgotten, of the failed coercions of an earlier system and the depopulation of hundreds of villages, of laborers forced to dig canals and embankments on an unprecedented scale and farmers made to grow crops they could not eat, of permits and travel restrictions and the spread of new epidemic diseases, of rebellions crushed with overwhelming force and prisons and labor camps filled and refilled. Scarcely a word about these events is found in the standard histories of how the universal right of property arrived, and today they can be only partially retold.
zh: 法律的地方起源必然被隐藏，因为它们存在于权力、纪律、强制和剥夺的问题之中。它们与一些如今大多已被遗忘的具体历史纠缠在一起：旧制度的强制尝试失败，数百座村庄人口流失；劳工被迫以空前的规模挖掘运河和堤坝，农民被迫种植自己不能吃的作物；许可证和旅行限制，新流行病的传播；起义被压倒性武力镇压，监狱和劳改营一批批填满又填满。在关于普遍产权如何到来的标准历史中，几乎找不到关于这些事件的只言片语；今天，人们也只能部分地重新讲述它们。

en: The colonial presentation of law as a conceptual structure brought from abroad performs the silencing of the actuality out of which property is made. But it is not just the colonial legal texts that produce this difference. The very act of colonial occupation produces it. By the time the law of property was in place, the British could claim that the days of the old abuses were over. The colonial occupation marked a rupture with the past, and the arbitrary rule of despots had given way to the rule of law.
zh: 殖民者把法律呈现为从国外带来的概念结构，这一做法本身就在压制产权由以形成的现实。但制造这种差异的不仅仅是殖民法律文本。殖民占领这一行动本身就制造了它。到产权法就位时，英国人已经可以声称旧日弊政的日子结束了。殖民占领标志着与过去的决裂，君主的专断统治已经让位于法治。

en: The rupture of colonial occupation was not a complete break with the past, however. The rule of property consolidated by the British confirmed a distribution and control of land put in place over the preceding decades. The exceptions, privileges, injustices, and coercions that produced this distribution of power and resources were to become a permanent part of the new order. The new legal order, rather than ending exceptional forms of control, created a thousand arbitrary powers. Every one of the new private estates, with their high walls and fortresslike gates, was its own sovereignty, a private realm of arbitrariness. Law was presented as the opposite of violence, exception, arbitrariness, and injustice, yet somehow these features were all incorporated within it. How could law be both order and violence, justice and injustice, universal and exceptional?
zh: 然而，殖民占领的断裂并不是与过去的彻底决裂。英国人所巩固的产权统治，确认了过去几十年间形成的土地分配和控制格局。造成这种权力和资源分配的那些例外、特权、不公和强制，将成为新秩序的永久组成部分。新的法律秩序并未终结例外形式的控制，反而创造了千百种专断权力。每一处新的私人地产，连同其高墙和堡垒式大门，都是自身的主权者，一个私人的专断领域。法律被呈现为暴力、例外、专断和不公的对立面，然而这些特征不知怎的都被纳入了法律之中。法律怎么可能既是秩序又是暴力，既是正义又是不义，既是普遍的又是例外的？

en: Rather than creating a rupture with arbitrary forms of power, the rule of law rearranged the arbitrariness. It redistributed its operations and its effects. The mechanism of this rearrangement was the estate. Law ruled on the outside, arbitrary power was hidden on the inside, just as it was hidden in the histories of the law. This happened at many levels, from the village strongman whose power was now that of local landowner to the larger estates of the absentee landlords, from the great domains of the ruling household to the state domain of the European banks, and beyond all these, the country as a whole, reorganized by the same methods as the domain of colonial power. Thus universal law was founded upon exceptions. Each of these domains was a zone of exceptionality, a sovereign territory within which the principles that established it did not apply.
zh: 法治并未与专断的权力形式决裂，而是重新安排了专断。它重新分配了专断的运作方式及其效果。这一重新安排的机制就是地产。法律在外面统治，专断权力被藏在里面，正如它被藏在法律史之中。这种情况发生在许多层面，从如今握有地方地主权力的村中豪强，到不在乡地主的较大地产，从统治家族的巨大领地，到欧洲银行的国有领地；而超出这一切之上，整个国家也以殖民权力领地的同样方法被重新组织。于是，普遍的法律建立在例外之上。这些领域各自都是一个例外地带，一片主权领土，确立它的那些原则在其中并不适用。

en: Since law must establish itself as the opposite of violence, and since principles become universal by fixing their difference from what is exceptional and local, the rearranging was also a process of denial, differentiation, and exclusion. The system of private property achieved this not only at what is called the level of language or representation, in writings like Artin’s that presented law as a conceptual system. It built the difference between the actual and the ideal, the material and conceptual, into the architecture of the countryside. The estate divided the world into law on one side and land on the other, abstraction versus material reality. The ʿizba was much more than a prison. It was a principle of order. It presented the new structure of difference, enacting it in the regularity of its lines and the repetition of its forms. These inscribed the effect of an absolute opposition: on one side an agricultural colony consisting of labor, animals, resources, implements, and land, all of them now objects to be owned; on the other, administration, bookkeeping, order, property, the right of ownership.
zh: 既然法律必须把自己确立为暴力的对立面，既然原则要通过固定自身与例外和地方性之物的差异而变得普遍，那么这种重新安排同时也是一个否认、区分和排斥的过程。私有产权制度不仅在所谓语言或表征的层面——在阿尔廷之类把法律呈现为概念体系的著作中——实现了这一点。它把实际与理想、物质与概念之间的差异，建造进了乡村的建筑之中。地产把世界分为一边的法律和另一边的土地，抽象与物质现实。伊兹巴远不止是一座监狱。它是一种秩序原则。它呈现了新的差异结构，以其线条的规整和形式的重复将这一结构付诸实施。这些线条和形式铭刻了一种绝对对立的效果：一边是由劳动力、牲畜、资源、工具和土地组成的农业殖民地，所有这些如今都成了被占有的对象；另一边是管理、簿记、秩序、产权、所有权。

en: The production of private property created the object quality of modern space. The forces, powers, processes, and claims whose tension and interaction gave rise to rural life were to be replaced by a world resolved into two dimensions, the inert materiality of land on one side, legal codes and property rights on the other. Thing versus idea, reality versus abstraction, space versus its meaning. With the rapid expansion of the estate system, these methods became a central feature of the production of “Egypt” itself as a closely managed geographical and political object. Alongside the system of estates, several other processes employed similar methods in a new politics of the production of space. In the later nineteenth and early twentieth centuries, practices such as the demarcation and policing of frontiers, the transformation of the country’s agriculture from a system based on capturing floodwaters to one based on permanent canals, and the overcoming of distances through the construction of railways, roads, shipping canals, and telegraphs all involved the creation of surfaces and enclosures that could be opened, closed, extended, mastered, and improved. Producing Egypt as an object of state power was the outcome of these novel techniques.
zh: 私有产权的生产创造了现代空间的客体性。那些其张力与互动造就了乡村生活的力量、权力、过程和主张，将被一个分解为两个维度的世界所取代：一边是土地惰性的物质性，另一边是法律法典和产权。物与观念，现实与抽象，空间与其意义。随着地产制度的迅速扩张，这些方法成为“埃及”本身作为一个受到严密管理的地理与政治对象的中心特征。与地产制度并行，还有其他几个过程在一种新的空间生产政治中采用了类似的方法。在19世纪后期和20世纪初，划定和巡逻边界、把该国农业从基于拦蓄洪水的体系转变为基于常设运河的体系，以及通过修建铁路、公路、航运运河和电报来克服距离，这些实践都涉及创造可以打开、关闭、扩展、掌控和改进的表面与围合。把埃及生产为国家权力的对象，正是这些新技术的产物。

en: Most of the time we take for granted the notion that land and even labor are objects, commodities that can be bought and sold. Following Marx, it is possible to say that turning labor into a commodity marked a violent act of alienation in which human life, a living force, was reduced to the status of a thing. Following Lefebvre, it is possible to make a parallel argument about land. The “production of space,” as Lefebvre termed the transformation of landscape into object, leveled the “natural and sacred contours” of the landscape under the exchange values and sign systems of capital.

Both are arguments of alienation that trace how a living reality is reified, turned into a mere thing. They are arguments of misrecognition: capitalist relations of exchange disguise the real social relations and natural values embodied in living forces. They are powerful arguments, but they are arguments that work within a binary or dialectical logic. They oppose nature, a living actuality, to a nonpresent, regulating ideality. We have located the power of law in a further series of binarisms—those that appear to establish the universality of law by securing its difference from the actuality of colonial history, the ideality of property in terms of its difference from the materiality of land and labor, and the order of colonial rule in terms of its difference from the arbitrary violence of the past. If our goal is to destabilize these dualisms, then a critique that rests on a dialectical logic, however powerful, cannot serve. The law of property does not take nature or life and turn them into objects. Law is produced as the difference between the ideality of rights and the physicality of nature, between the abstraction of the code and the actuality of life. The concepts of nature or life in which a dialectical critique is grounded are produced in the political process we are examining.
zh: 大多数时候，我们把土地乃至劳动力是物品、是可以买卖的商品这一观念视为理所当然。循着马克思，可以说把劳动力变成商品标志着一种暴力的异化行为，人的生命这一活生生的力量被降格为物的地位。循着列斐伏尔，可以对土地提出一个平行的论点。列斐伏尔把景观转变为客体的过程称为“空间的生产”，它用资本的交换价值和符号系统抹平了景观“自然与神圣的轮廓”。

两者都是异化的论证，追溯一种活生生的现实如何被物化，变成单纯的物。它们也是误认的论证：资本主义的交换关系掩盖了活生生的力量所体现的真实社会关系和自然价值。这些论证很有力，但它们是在一种二元或辩证逻辑内部运作的论证。它们把自然、活生生的实际，与非在场的、规制性的理想对立起来。我们已经在进一步的一系列二元论中定位了法律的权力——这些二元论似乎通过确保法律与殖民历史实际的差异来确立法律的普遍性，通过产权与土地和劳动力物质性的差异来确立产权的理想性，通过殖民统治与过去专断暴力的差异来确立殖民统治的秩序。如果我们的目标是动摇这些二元论，那么一种立足于辩证逻辑的批评无论多么有力，都无法胜任。产权法并不是把自然或生命变成对象。法律是作为权利理想性与自然物理性之间的差异、法典抽象性与生活实际性之间的差异而被生产出来的。辩证批评所依据的自然或生命概念，正是在我们考察的政治过程中被生产出来的。

en: The principle of abstraction on which the order of law depends can be generated only as the difference between order and violence, the ideal and the actual, the universal and the exceptional. But the violent, the actual, and the exceptional—all of which the law denounces and excludes, ruptures itself from and supersedes—are never gone. They make possible the rupture, the denunciation, and the order. They are the condition of its possibility.
zh: 法律秩序所依赖的抽象原则，只能作为秩序与暴力、理想与实际、普遍与例外之间的差异而被生成。但暴力的、实际的和例外的东西——法律谴责并排斥、与之决裂并加以取代的这一切——从未消失。它们使决裂、谴责和秩序成为可能。它们是秩序可能性的条件。

en: The more senior officials received estates of one thousand acres or more, but most were given amounts between one and two hundred acres. Amin Sami, Taqwim al-nil wa-asmaʾ man tawallaw amr misr wa-muddat hukmihim ʿalayha wa-mulahazat taʾrikhiyya ʿan ahwal al-khilafa al-ʿamma wa-shuʾun misr al-khassa, vol. 3., in 3 parts, 1264–1289 (1848–1872) (Cairo: Matbaʿat Dar al-Kutub, 1936), 3:490–93, 496–97, 499–500, 502–5, 513–16, 518–21, 529–39, 542, 561.

en: Yacoub Artin, La Propriété foncière en Egypte, printed under the Auspices of the Ministry of Finance (Cairo: Institut Egyptien, 1883). Artin notes that it was Sir Auckland Colvin, the English controller at the Ministry of Finance in Cairo, who proposed that the ministry fund the publication of his study. The following year an Italian study of Ottoman property law by Domenico Gatteschi, published in Alexandria in 1869, was translated into English by Edward Van Dyck and published under the title Real Property, Mortgage, and Wakf According to Ottoman Law (London:Wyman and Sons, 1884).
zh: 雅各布·阿尔廷（Yacoub Artin），《埃及的土地产权》（La Propriété foncière en Egypte），财政部赞助出版（Cairo: Institut Egyptien, 1883）。阿尔廷指出，正是开罗财政部英国财务监督奥克兰·科尔文爵士（Sir Auckland Colvin）提议由财政部资助其研究的出版。次年，多梅尼科·加泰斯基（Domenico Gatteschi）1869年于亚历山大港出版的意大利语奥斯曼财产法研究，由爱德华·范戴克（Edward Van Dyck）译成英文，以《依奥斯曼法之不动产、抵押与瓦克夫》（Real Property, Mortgage, and Wakf According to Ottoman Law；London: Wyman and Sons, 1884）为题出版。

en: Artin drew especially on Noma Denis Fustel de Coulanges, La Cité antique, 9th ed. (Paris: Hachette, 1881). He turned to this work after failing to derive any conclusive view of Islamic property rights from Islamic legal sources (La Propriété foncière, 68–82). Kenneth Cuno, The Pasha’s Peasants: Land, Society and Economy in Lower Egypt, 1740–1858 (Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 1992), 204–5, traces the French view to the work of the orientalist Silvestre de Sacy, and discusses the sources in Islamic law from which de Sacy derived his analysis.
zh: 阿尔廷尤其借鉴了努马·德尼·菲斯泰尔·德·库朗热（Numa Denis Fustel de Coulanges），《古代城邦》（La Cité antique），第9版（Paris: Hachette, 1881）。他是在无法从伊斯兰法律资料中得出关于伊斯兰财产权的确定看法之后转向此书的（《埃及的土地产权》，第68—82页）。肯尼思·库诺（Kenneth Cuno），《帕夏的农民：下埃及的土地、社会与经济，1740—1858》（The Pasha’s Peasants: Land, Society and Economy in Lower Egypt, 1740–1858；Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 1992），第204—205页，把这一法国观点追溯到东方学家西尔维斯特·德·萨西（Silvestre de Sacy）的著作，并讨论了德·萨西分析所依据的伊斯兰法资料。

en: Fustel de Coulanges published La Cité antique in 1864 at the height of the controversy over French land seizures, ignited by the criticisms of Ismayl Urbain, a creole from French Guiana who traveled with the Saint-Simonians to Egypt in the 1830s, became an interpreter and advisor to the French in Algeria, and then published a pamphlet (under the pseudonym Georges Voisin) attacking the land seizures, L’Algérie pour les Algériens (Paris: Michel Lévy Frères, 1861). See John David Ragan, “A Fascination for the Exotic: Suzanne Volquin, Ismayl Urbain, Jehan D’Ivray, and the Saint-Simonians—French Travelers in Egypt on the Margins” (Ph. D. diss., New York University, 2000), chap. 7.
zh: 菲斯泰尔·德·库朗热于1864年出版《古代城邦》，正值法国土地夺取争议的高潮；争议由伊兹梅尔·于尔班（Ismayl Urbain）的批评引发。于尔班是法属圭亚那的克里奥尔人，19世纪30年代随圣西门主义者前往埃及，后成为法国在阿尔及利亚的译员和顾问，随后以乔治·沃瓦桑（Georges Voisin）为笔名发表小册子《阿尔及利亚属于阿尔及利亚人》（L’Algérie pour les Algériens；Paris: Michel Lévy Frères, 1861），抨击土地夺取。参见约翰·戴维·拉根（John David Ragan），“对异域的迷恋：苏珊娜·沃尔坎、伊兹梅尔·于尔班、让·迪夫雷与圣西门主义者——处于边缘的法国埃及旅行者”（“A Fascination for the Exotic: Suzanne Volquin, Ismayl Urbain, Jehan D’Ivray, and the Saint-Simonians—French Travelers in Egypt on the Margins”）（博士论文，New York University, 2000），第7章。

en: Gabriel Baer, A History of Landownership in Modern Egypt, 1800–1950 (Oxford: Oxford University Press, 1962).

en: On this rupturing, see Jacques Derrida, “The Force of Law,” Cardozo Law Review 11 (1990). Samera Esmair explores the implications of Derrida’s work in an insightful essay on colonial law, “Colonies of Legalities,” unpublished paper, May 2000, to which I am indebted. On the question of the contradictions in European liberal theory made apparent by colonialism, see Uday Mehta, Liberalism and Empire: A Study in Nineteenth-Century British Liberal Thought (Chicago: University of Chicago Press, 1999).
zh: 关于这种断裂，参见雅克·德里达（Jacques Derrida），“法律的力量”（“The Force of Law”），Cardozo Law Review 11 (1990)。萨梅拉·埃斯迈尔（Samera Esmair）在一篇关于殖民法律的富有洞见的论文中探讨了德里达著作的含义，“法律性的殖民地”（“Colonies of Legalities”），未刊论文，2000年5月；本文得益于该文。关于殖民主义使欧洲自由主义理论矛盾显现的问题，参见乌代·梅塔（Uday Mehta），《自由主义与帝国：19世纪英国自由主义思想研究》（Liberalism and Empire: A Study in Nineteenth-Century British Liberal Thought；Chicago: University of Chicago Press, 1999）。

en: Cuno, The Pasha’s Peasants. For a re-examination of the scholarly discussions before the nineteenth century, see Baber Johansen, The Islamic Law on Land Tax and Rent: The Peasant Loss of Property Rights as Interpreted in the Hanafite Legal Literature of the Mamluk and Ottoman Periods (London: Croom Helm, 1988).
zh: 库诺，《帕夏的农民》。关于19世纪以前学术讨论的重新审视，参见巴伯·约翰森（Baber Johansen），《伊斯兰法中的土地税与地租：马穆鲁克与奥斯曼时期哈乃斐法律文献所阐释的农民产权丧失》（The Islamic Law on Land Tax and Rent: The Peasant Loss of Property Rights as Interpreted in the Hanafite Legal Literature of the Mamluk and Ottoman Periods；London: Croom Helm, 1988）。

en: Huri Islamoglu-Inan, State and Peasant in the Ottoman Empire:Agrarian Power Relations and Regional Economic Development in Ottoman Anatolia during the Sixteenth Century (Leiden: E. J. Brill, 1994), chaps. 1 and 3; and “Property as a Contested Domain:A Re-Evaluation of the Ottoman Land Code of 1858,” unpublished paper, 1999. Baber Johansen shows that the development of large estates in the classical period was legitimated by Hanafite jurists by means of a complex legal fiction, whereby tenants were considered to be engaged, hour by hour, in a continuous “purchase” of the land’s produce. The fiction was necessary, Johansen explains, because the yield of the land was held to be a relation (in Abdellah Hammoudi’s terms) rather than a substance. In the Ottoman period, jurists attempted to reestablish the legitimacy of these estates with another complex fiction, by which the estates were imagined to have been obtained through original purchase from the ruler—the only source, in Ottoman doctrine, of legitimate revenue claims. Johansen, Islamic Law on Land Tax; Abdellah Hammoudi, “Substance and Relation: Water Rights and Water Distribution in the Dra Valley,” in Property, Social Structure and Law in the Modern Middle East, ed. Ann Elizabeth Mayer (Albany: State University of New York Press, 1985), 27–57.
zh: 胡里·伊斯兰奥卢-伊南（Huri Islamoglu-Inan），《奥斯曼帝国的国家与农民：16世纪奥斯曼安纳托利亚的土地权力关系与区域经济发展》（State and Peasant in the Ottoman Empire: Agrarian Power Relations and Regional Economic Development in Ottoman Anatolia during the Sixteenth Century；Leiden: E. J. Brill, 1994），第1、3章；以及“作为争议领域的产权：对1858年奥斯曼土地法的重新评价”（“Property as a Contested Domain: A Re-Evaluation of the Ottoman Land Code of 1858”），未刊论文，1999。巴伯·约翰森表明，古典时期大型地产的发展由哈乃斐法学家借助一种复杂的法律拟制获得正当性：佃户被认为逐时不断地“购买”土地的产出。约翰森解释说，这一拟制之所以必要，是因为土地的收益被视为一种关系（用阿卜杜拉·哈穆迪的话说），而非一种实体。到奥斯曼时期，法学家试图用另一种复杂的拟制重建这类地产的合法性：这些地产被想象为通过向统治者原始购买而获得——在奥斯曼学说中，这是合法收入主张的唯一来源。约翰森，《伊斯兰法中的土地税与地租》；阿卜杜拉·哈穆迪（Abdellah Hammoudi），“实体与关系：德拉河谷的水权与分水”（“Substance and Relation: Water Rights and Water Distribution in the Dra Valley”），载安·伊丽莎白·迈耶（Ann Elizabeth Mayer）编，《现代中东的产权、社会结构与法律》（Property, Social Structure and Law in the Modern Middle East；Albany: State University of New York Press, 1985），第27—57页。

en: Lozach and Hug, L’Habitat rural, 156–59. The word ʿizba originally referred to the temporary straw huts built by cultivators to provide seasonal shelter in the fields for those working at a distance from the village. In the early 1860s official documents refer to ʿizbas in terms suggesting that they were already found quite widely—and that their isolation on the new estates represented a particular problem of security. Departing for Istanbul just after assuming power in January 1863, Ismaʿil sent orders by telegraph to all his provincial officials instructing them to look after the well-being and security of the inhabitants of all towns and villages, “and especially the inhabitants of the ʿizbas isolated from them.” Sami, Taqwim al-nil, 3:463.

zh: 埃及政府出版社，《地名索引》（Index to Place Names；Cairo: Egyptian Government Press, 1932），转引自亨利·哈比卜·艾鲁特（Henry Habib Ayrout），《费拉赫》（Fellahs；Cairo: Editions Horus, 1942），第111页注1。在埃及的14,166个地名中，有7,800个带有“伊兹巴”前缀。这少于地产总数，因为许多伊兹巴并未取得独立村庄或小村的地位。

en: Some estates were created informally by powerful local households through the purchase of village land. Since they were not granted by the ruling family, such properties would continue to be counted as village land in the tax registers (Owen,“Development of Agricultural Production,” 147–48). But even property acquired by the ruling family and its officials might continue to be registered as village land. For example, on January 12, 1864, Ismaʿil transferred to his son Ibrahim Pasha two thousand acres he controlled in the Delta villages of Kafr al-Batikh, Kafr Sulayman al-Bahri, and Suwalim, together with “all their stores, equipment and supplies.” The order he issued to the administrator of his estates indicates that more than three-quarters of the land was classified as village (athariyya) land and less than one-quarter as estate (ʿushr) land. Khedival order of 2 Shaʿban 1280h (Jan. 12, 1864), in Sami, Taqwim al-nil, 3:533.
zh: 有些地产是有权势的地方家族通过购买村庄土地非正式形成的。由于它们不是统治家族赐予的，这类产业在税收登记册中仍继续计为村庄土地（欧文，“农业生产的发展”，第147—148页）。但即使是统治家族及其官员获得的产业，也可能继续登记为村庄土地。例如，1864年1月12日，伊斯梅尔把他在三角洲卡夫尔·巴提赫、卡夫尔·苏莱曼·巴赫里和苏瓦利姆等村控制的两千费丹土地，连同“其全部仓库、设备和供应品”，转让给他的儿子易卜拉欣帕夏。他发给地产管理人的命令表明，其中四分之三以上的土地被归类为村庄（athariyya）土地，不到四分之一为地产（ʿushr）土地。1280h年舍尔邦月2日（1864年1月12日）的总督敕令，载萨米，《尼罗河纪年》，第3卷：533。

en: In many cases the seizure of village land was constructed as a “sale,” in which the cultivator exchanged his land for an equivalent plot elsewhere. In practice the cultivator was never given the alternative plot, or was allocated land in a different part of the country, or found the new plot already cultivated by others. ʿAli Barakat, Tatawwur al-milkiyya al-ziraʿiyya fi misr waatharuhu ʿala al-haraka al-siyasiyya (Cairo: Dar al-Thaqafa al-Jadida, 1977), 287–91.
zh: 许多情况下，对村庄土地的夺取被构造为一次“买卖”：耕种者用他的土地换取别处一块等价的土地。实际上，耕种者从未得到替代地块，或者被分配到国内另一个地方的土地，或者发现新地块已由他人耕种。阿里·巴拉卡特（ʿAli Barakat），《埃及农业产权的发展及其对政治运动的影响》（Tatawwur al-milkiyya al-ziraʿiyya fi misr wa-atharuhu ʿala al-haraka al-siyasiyya；Cairo: Dar al-Thaqafa al-Jadida, 1977），第287—291页。

en: Barakat, Tatawwur al-milkiyya al-ziraʿiyya, 297. Most estates were created from village land that was not registered as tax-paying, categorized either as untaxed (ibʿadiyya), abandoned (matruka), or additional to the area surveyed (ziyadat al-misaha). However, none of these taxation categories necessarily implied that the land was uncultivated.
zh: 巴拉卡特，《埃及农业产权的发展》，第297页。大多数地产是用未登记为纳税的村庄土地形成的，这些土地被归类为免税地（ibʿadiyya）、荒弃地（matruka）或测量面积之外的附加地（ziyadat al-misaha）。然而，这些税收类别都不必然意味着土地未开垦。

en: Five separate European bodies controlled Egyptian finances after 1876: the Public Debt Commission controlled the revenue from provincial government taxes, the local customs duties (octrois) of Cairo and Alexandria, the foreign customs of Egyptian ports other than Alexandria, and the salt and tobacco taxes, among others; the Railway and Port Commission controlled the revenues of the Egyptian railways and the port of Alexandria; the Khedive’s estates (the Daʾira Saniya, or Sanieh), mostly sugarcane plantations in the south, were managed by the Daʾira Sanieh Administration; and from 1878 other Khedival estates, transferred to the state and renamed state domain, were administered by the Dominial Commission. Each of these bodies took the entire revenue under their control to service a different group of bank loans. Revenue from any other source went to the Egyptian government, but even so remained under foreign supervision: two controllers, one French and one English, directed all government revenue and expenditure. For an account of these arrangements see Herbert Feis, Europe: The World’s Banker, 1870–1914: An Account of European Foreign Investment and the Connection of World Finance with Diplomacy Before the War (New Haven, Conn.: Yale University Press, 1930, reprint ed. Clifton, N.J.: Augustus M. Kelley, 1974), 382–97.
zh: 1876年后，五个各自独立的欧洲机构控制着埃及财政：公债委员会控制省政府税收入、开罗和亚历山大港的地方入市税（octrois）、除亚历山大港以外埃及各港的对外关税以及盐税和烟草税等项目的收入；铁路和港口委员会控制埃及铁路及亚历山大港的收入；总督的领地（Daʾira Saniya，或称Sanieh），主要是南方的甘蔗种植园，由达伊拉·萨尼耶管理局管理；从1878年起，移交给国家并改名为国有领地的其他总督领地，由领地委员会管理。这些机构各自把其控制下的全部收入用于偿付不同组的银行贷款。来自任何其他来源的收入归埃及政府，但即便如此仍处于外国监督之下：两名监督官，一法一英，掌管政府的一切收入和支出。关于这些安排的叙述，见赫伯特·法伊斯（Herbert Feis），《欧洲：世界的银行家，1870—1914：战前欧洲对外投资及世界金融与外交关系述论》（Europe: The World’s Banker, 1870–1914: An Account of European Foreign Investment and the Connection of World Finance with Diplomacy Before the War；New Haven, Conn.: Yale University Press, 1930；重印本 Clifton, N.J.: Augustus M. Kelley, 1974），第382—397页。
